segments.title: Intro
segments.text: This overview uses a device voice. No AI voice service is called. Fire Atlas maps NASA microgravity fire tests against the air of future habitats. Every dot opens its source.

segments.title: The map
segments.text: Pick a habitat, then read the map. Oxygen and pressure are plotted only when a table reports them. Rows without a value are marked unknown. The gap sentence is computed by code from those rows.

segments.title: Outro
segments.text: The map shows what has been tested near a chosen atmosphere, and what has not. NASA does not endorse this project. The evidence stays free.
